title: Sunset orchestration roadmap for API v1 -> v2: release notes & GTM checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: execute a low-friction, audit-ready deprecation of API v1 in favor of API v2 while preserving customer trust and minimizing breakage. This ticket contains the orchestration roadmap across product, engineering, docs, SDKs, console, support, and GTM.

Scope: public HTTP/REST API v1 endpoints and legacy SDK bindings that default to v1. Not in scope: internal admin endpoints and private partner integrations (handled separately via partner program).

Success criteria: 
- 95% of active non-enterprise customers migrated to v2 or using a documented compatibility variant before sunset date.
- No customer-facing P0 regressions attributable to the migration.
- Release notes, migration guides, and tooling published at least 30 days before mandatory cutoff.

Key risks: tokenization/format changes, SDK default behavior changes, rollout timing overlapping major customer launches. Mitigations below.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Public migration guide published and linked in Console and API docs. 2) Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal & Security, and staged in product release notes system. 3) SDKs (python, node, java) have compatibility helpers and deprecation warnings in 2.0.0 release. 4) Console flag + banner for affected customers enabled 60/30/14-day cadence. 5) Monitoring dashboard to track v1/v2 traffic, error rates, and migrations is live.
deliverables:
- Migration guide (docs.redwood.com/confluence/migrate-v1-to-v2)
- Release notes draft and staged entries in release-notes repo
- SDK compatibility helpers & codemods (github.com/redwood/sdk-migration)
- Console banner + admin opt-out UI
- Automated email/Slack templates for customer comms
- Rollback checklist and incident runbook
- Post-mortem template and KPI dashboard
owners: Product: Morgan Chen; Engineering runtime: Leo Fernandez; SDKs: Priya Rao; Docs: Ben Kim; Design/Console: Elena Ruiz; Support: Omar Singh; Legal/Trust: Claire Dubois; GTM owner: Sasha Martinez
comms_timeline:
T-90 days: announce deprecation intent (blog + tenant banner + targeted emails to teams flagged in usage).
T-60 days: publish migration guide + SDK migration PRs; enable console banner with link to guide.
T-30 days: publish formal release notes and sent targeted migration plans to top 50 customers; sales & CSM enablement kit distributed.
T-14 days: final warning email, add deprecation headers to API responses (X-Deprecation: v1; deprecate-on: 2026-05-15).
Cutoff (2026-05-15): v1 access default removed; fallback policy for known enterprise exceptions enforced via dedicated capacity ticketing.
Post-cutoff +7d: grace period for emergency fixes; daily deprecation dashboard review for first 14 days.
+30/90/180 day check-ins: adoption metrics and learnings documented.
release_notes_plan: Owner: Morgan. Template: (1) Summary of change + reason for deprecation, (2) Impacted endpoints and SDKs, (3) Migration steps with code snippets, (4) Rollback & support instructions, (5) Timeline & dates. Reviewers: Legal, Security, Docs, Engineering. Distribution: release-notes site, Console banner, Changelog RSS, & email to active API key owners. Staged GitHub PR: GH-PR-6582 (release notes), linked to SDK PRs for synchronized version bumps.
migration_guide_summary:
- Step 0: identify API keys and services calling v1 (query admin logs).
- Step 1: update client to call /v2/ endpoints and set api-version header.
- Step 2: run SDK codemod to update response parsing (node/python codemods available).
- Step 3: run integration test suite against the v2 compatibility sandbox (sandbox.redwood.com/v2).
- Step 4: enable canary switch in runtime for 5% traffic, monitor errors & latency for 48h, then ramp.
- Edge cases: advise customers on streaming response semantics change and token counter differences; provide snippets for prefix caching behavior changes.
- Tools: migration-codex CLI, compatibility-checker job (ENG-4021) that outputs a migration readiness report.
rollback_plan:
If we see a production P0 traced to a widespread v2 regression:
1) Immediately pause the v1 shutdown gate and re-enable fallback routing to v1 variant for affected customers.
2) Post incident channels: #incidents, on-call ENG runtime pager.
3) Hotfix path: prepare emergency patch release for v2 SDKs or runtime compatibility shim.
4) Communicate status every 2 hours to impacted customers and CSMs.
Ownership: ENG runtime lead + Product on-call. Post-mortem required within 72 hours.
monitoring_kpis:
- % of requests on v2 vs v1 (goal: 95% on v2 by cutoff)
- Error rate delta (v2 vs baseline)
- Latency P50/P95/P99 before/after migration
- Number of open migration tickets created by Support
- SDK adoption by package manager downloads and github releases
